sn22.51:1.2: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu sees as impermanent form which is actually impermanent: that is his right view.
sn22.51:1.4: With the destruction of delight comes the destruction of lust; with the destruction of lust comes the destruction of delight.
sn22.51:1.5: With the destruction of delight and lust the mind is liberated and is said to be well liberated.
sn22.51:1.6: “A bhikkhu sees as impermanent feeling which is actually impermanent …
sn22.51:1.11: volitional formations which are actually impermanent …
sn22.51:1.15: consciousness which is actually impermanent: that is his right view….
sn22.51:1.17: With the destruction of delight and lust the mind is liberated and is said to be well liberated.”
